text.en: With privilege must come responsibility. I feel that financial freedom asks something of me. It gives me choices about how to spend my time, what risks I can take, and what I can make possible for others. Those choices carry a responsibility to act, to consider the consequences of my actions, to continue educating myself, and to pursue greater change in society. This feels like a duty. It is also connected to my sense of meaning—to what I want my life to contribute and what I feel called to pursue. The thought came to me in the shower yesterday. There was an emotional clarity to it, an urgency that made me want to write. Today, I can still recognize the thought, but I cannot access it in quite the same way.
